review_notes_zh: Reviewer cleanup: backpressure delayed-event requeue now routes overflowed events to DLQ instead of silent drop.

handoffs.message: TEL-002 ready for review. All artifacts implemented: durable buffer (InMemoryBuffer v1 + RedisStreamBuffer v2-ready), async batch writer with micro-batching/retry/partition-routing, backpressure controller with adaptive concurrency, dead-letter queue with JSONL spill/replay/diagnostic-tags, TelemetryIngestService. 38/38 unit tests pass. 4/4 smoke tests pass. BUFFER_CHOICE_ADR.md documents tradeoffs.
Approved after reviewer cleanup: delay-path overflow now lands in DLQ, regression test added, and ADR durability wording is aligned with the actual v1 implementation.
